handoff: Review#2 approve: no blocking findings on spec or standards; bun test 1208 pass, typecheck green; review#1 blockers fixed. Minor: run view --why/--receipt refusals print markdown without --json (JSON identical); help --all test can't fail until a group is hidden (slice 14). Nits: N+1 trace loads in run-id lookup, verb-name string surgery, duplicated ULID test.

findings.title: --why/--receipt refusals print markdown, success prints JSON
findings.detail:
run view sets markdown:true, so without --json the no_tick/no_decision/usage refusals of --why print as markdown where `norn why` printed CliError JSON, while a successful --why still prints JSON. --json output and exit codes are identical, so AC5 holds.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Decide on purpose: render --why for a person, or document that it stays JSON.

findings.title: help --all test passes without --all
findings.detail:
No help group is hidden yet, so checking every command appears in `help --all` stdout would pass without the flag.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: In slice 14, assert a hidden command is absent from plain help and present with --all.

findings.title: Run-id lookup reloads the trace view per story
findings.detail:
loadTraceView per story rescans worktrees and reloads snapshot each time (N+1). Fine at current scale.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Load snapshot once and pass it in, if it gets slow.

findings.title: Verb identity as space-joined string
findings.detail:
`run list` is split again with name.split(' ')[0] (help.ts) and slice(name.length+1) (cli.ts, help.ts); ULID test duplicated in commands/run-view.ts and view/src/run-view.ts; `"hidden" in g && g.hidden` vs `g.hidden` checks differ.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Give a verb a `verb` field or parent ref; let loadRunView classify the target.
